 And she drank fish-brine
 [פיש שמאלץ — fish shmalts — Yiddish: fish brine or fat; a folk remedy taken after childbirth or illness to restore strength].
 May Hashem Yisbarach send her a complete healing.

segments.en: And on account of his anger he himself suffers greatly.

Therefore I must write this week several letters.
